# open-lowmem

> Windows launchers that run a 125B-parameter MoE model (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) locally on a 24 GB GPU with 32 GB RAM through the Strata inference engine, and connect it to Claude Code, OpenCode, the Claude desktop app and Open WebUI.

Author: Liao Yichen (廖亦辰), Xiamen, China. GitHub: bathfire-dev. License: MIT.

Measured speed (this repo's dev machine: RTX 4090D 24 GB, 32 GB RAM, IQ2_XS, Windows, 2026-10-07): 8 runs of 512 generated tokens gave 62-94 tokens/s, median about 77, one request at a time with a short prompt.

Facts (memory figures are from the Strata documentation, not measured here):
- Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ2_XS needs about 39.2 GB of combined RAM and VRAM; Q2_0 about 37.6 GB.
- Strata needs a 12 GB or larger NVIDIA/AMD GPU, 32 GB or more RAM, about 80 GB free disk.
- Strata exposes an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint on 127.0.0.1:8090; claude-strata.exe launches Claude Code against it with a --settings overlay.
- The Claude desktop path is experimental and not verified end to end.
- Windows only. Not affiliated with Anthropic, Alibaba Cloud, Strata or OpenCode. Third-party software and model weights are not included.
